style: Courtside, not corporate. Flat, confident, athletic energy over live volleyball footage. Yellow-on-transparent, no soft glows or hairlines — legibility over unpredictable video is the constraint. The play mark (nested in the d) is Flickday's one ownable geometric element and is the protagonist of the motion.

customize.why_this_block: logo-outro is the catalog's canonical logo-reveal block (piece-by-piece assembly + glow + tagline + URL pill). We reuse its piece-assembly choreography, which is transform/opacity-based and therefore compatible with our FILLED paths (stroke draw-on is unusable here).

overrides.glow_bloom: DISABLE — conflicts with the no-soft-glow legibility invariant (yellow mark composites over bright/unpredictable footage). Ignition punch comes from scale overshoot (back.out), not glow.
overrides.assembly_order: RE-SEQUENCE to play-mark-first: the play triangle fires as the ignition seed, then the letterform groups build out from it; the sequence REVERSES on exit (letters retract into the play mark, which punches out last). logo-outro's baked assembly order is not exposed as a customize variable, so this is an add + edit-the-script change, not a variable swap.
overrides.bind_to_paths: Bind the assembly to the supplied SVG's 9 potrace paths (grouped — see build_notes), not to logo-outro's own baked fragments.

customize.fallback: If logo-outro's baked assembly cannot be cleanly re-sequenced to lead with the play path, HAND-AUTHOR per the logo-reveal module's sanctioned fork: place the wordmark at its hero frame (CSS), reveal per-path-group via mask/scale/transform using the primitives named in content.motion, hold, then reverse. Same beats either way.

content.layout: Wordmark centered in the 1080x1920 frame as a horizontal band (mark is ~2.7:1 wide → ~900px wide at ~85% frame width, ~333px tall, optical center ~y=960). Vertical negative space above/below is intentional — it is a transparent overlay; the compositor positions it over footage. Per-path transform-origins at each path-group's own centroid for the ignition/settle; for the exit, letter groups translate toward the play-mark centroid + scale down (converge-and-collapse), so the Builder needs the play-mark centroid as the exit convergence point.
content.motif: play-mark ignition — the play triangle nested in the d is the protagonist; letterforms build out from it, and on exit retract back into it. One dominant motif, bookended by the play mark (first in, last out).

motion.ignition: scale_punch on the play triangle — from { scale:.6, opacity:0, ease:'back.out(2.2)' } (impact/energetic).
motion.letter_build: staggered scale_grow / slide per letter-GROUP — from { scale:0|y:+40, opacity:0, ease:'power2.out' }, stagger ~0.06s per group, emanating from the d/play-mark. Left-to-right is the safe default if a radial order reads muddy.
motion.settle: slight back.out overshoot into the final CSS end-state to sell the snap.
motion.hold_life: optional whole-lockup hold_breath at ~1.015 scale (sine.inOut) — ambient only, must NOT read as a second 'change'.
motion.signature_pulse: the SINGLE pattern-interrupt at the mid-hold — play triangle scale_pulse to 1.10 (yoyo, sine.inOut). NO glow (invariant).
motion.letter_retract: reverse stagger — scale_out / slide_out, each letter-group collapses toward the play-mark centroid (opacity→0, ease:'power2.in').
motion.punch_out: play triangle exits LAST — scale_out to 1.06 + opacity→0 (power2.in).

beat_table.motion: canvas fully empty (transparent) — nothing on screen
scale_punch back.out(2.2), opacity 0->1 — the hook, lands by 0.5s
staggered scale_grow/slide, ~0.06s per group, emanating from the play mark (anticipates the ignition land by ~0.1s)
snap to end-state with slight back.out overshoot
static, flat, legible (optional ambient hold_breath 1.015) — the money frame for compositing
scale_pulse 1.10 yoyo sine.inOut — the one pattern-interrupt, no glow
reverse stagger scale_out/slide_out, collapse toward play-mark centroid, opacity->0 power2.in
canvas fully empty — guarantees a clear final frame for CapCut

build_notes: Scaffold index.html ships at 1920x1080 blank example — Builder must reset canvas to 1080x1920 (9:16 vertical) to match this envelope.

PATH STRUCTURE (verified from the SVG, do not re-assume): 9 <path> elements inside one <g fill="#facc15"> (fill is on the <g>, inherited); transform translate(0,1636) scale(0.1,-0.1) confirms potrace y-flip. The 9 paths DO NOT map 1:1 to the 8 letters + triangle. Three short paths (~108/114/185 chars of d-string) cluster in the left l-i region (x~825-1078 in the SVG's internal 0.1-scaled space) — these are sub-letter fragments (the i's tittle, the i-stem, and/or the simple l stroke). Letters with counters (d, a) carry their counter as subpaths within one <path> d-string.

BEFORE choreographing: the Builder must (1) render each path with an index label to identify it visually, (2) identify WHICH path index is the play triangle (nested in the d's counter — this is the ignition seed and the exit convergence point), and (3) GROUP multi-path letters (i stem + tittle; confirm d/a counters) into single stagger units, so a letter's dot does not fly in on its own step and break the cascade. Result is ~7-8 stagger GROUPS, not 9 raw paths.
Copy wordmark-play.svg into the project assets/ and inline it so per-path elements are individually animatable.

No live text renders in v1 (SVG wordmark only) so no font embed is needed. Bebas Neue is a documented placeholder; if a tagline is ever added, the offline render requires it base64-embedded, never fetched.

LEGIBILITY-OVER-FOOTAGE: keep the mark pure yellow #facc15 on transparent — do NOT bake in backing; the compositor owns placement. If field legibility fails over bright/yellow footage, the sanctioned reinforcement is a FLAT, zero-blur offset shadow in a dark ink (a flat-design device), NEVER a soft glow. Offer as an option, not a default.
Final delivery is ProRes 4444 MOV (alpha) — that is a render-flag detail for the CLI, not a composition change.
shot_brief: A ~5s transparent bookend sting for CapCut compositing over volleyball footage. The single dominant motif is play-mark ignition: the play triangle nested in the d fires first as a fast, confident pop, and the remaining letterform groups build out from it in a quick staggered cascade (per-path masks/clip/transform/fade — no stroke-draw, the paths are filled), snapping into the settled lowercase 'flickday' wordmark. It holds flat and legible through the middle with a single signature pulse on the play mark as the pattern-interrupt, then closes the loop on exit: the letterforms retract back into the play mark, which punches out last. Because it composites as an overlay, frame 0 and the final frame are fully clear — nothing on screen before entrance or after exit — so it drops cleanly onto footage. Motion IS the message; no tagline, no URL, pure wordmark. Rendered as alpha-overlay (transparent), final delivery ProRes 4444 MOV.
